COUNTDOWN: 6 wks — map 42 objectives + weak topics; 4 wks — timed past Qs +
canvas rationales; 2 wks — cards (cutoffs, steps, plates, 25 points); 1 wk — mock + sleep;
eve — pack + rest; DAY — read twice, canvas-structure, cite modules, attempt ALL.
FORMULA: ABCD → flags → ONE counsel → treat+demo → family+safety → review. Meal plans:
targets → 3+snacks → Ghana foods → portions → fluids → demo → review. Interviews: STAR
from canvas ("our SAM graduation..."); "myths?" = negotiated-with-elders aloud.
PORTFOLIO CROWN: canvas + charts + QI + demos log + reflections + photos (consented,
de-identified). One finished nutrition project outranks ten certificates.
PLEDGE: "I will measure honestly, counsel ONE change kindly, demo always, trace defaulters
with love — rainbow plates, full dignity, every age."
